note: The Book of Laws and the faiths (v2). Laws: four chapters, each with two rival paths of two laws; a law enacted on one path closes its rival in that chapter until every law of the path is repealed. A crown may hold `slots[chapter index]` laws, needs the law's Authority and pays its crowns; a repealed law costs `repeal.love` Love and cannot return for `repeal.cooldown` months. Effects: crownsPct, productionPct, faithPct (shares more of the realm's yields), renown (a month), love, fear and unrest (a month), companyCost and upkeep (multipliers), defend (walls), integration (conquered cities settle faster), movePoints (marches), missionCost (a multiplier), faithUnrest (a multiplier on unrest from towns of another faith). Faiths: each city keeps a mix of faiths (Temerian towns from the real-time game's data, foreign ones from their realm's lean). Each month its owner's patron faith gains `spread.patron` plus `spread.perFaith` for each point of the city's faith yield, and the faith ruling each neighbour gains `spread.neighbour`; missionaries (`missions.cost` Devotion) add `missions.share` of our patron faith in a city within `missions.reach` links of our land. A city whose ruling faith is not its owner's patron adds `unrest` a month (at most `unrestCap`). Faith victory: a patron faith ruling `victory.share` of all cities wins for the power of that faith with the most Devotion.

laws.name: Assizes
laws.text: Travelling judges hear the commons in the king's name.

laws.name: Charter of the commons
laws.text: The crown swears to tax by custom and consent.

laws.name: Gallows in every town
laws.text: Justice is quick, and seen to be.

laws.name: Martial law in conquered towns
laws.text: Soldiers keep the peace where the crown is new.

laws.name: Guild charters
laws.text: The guilds train and organise the towns' crafts.

laws.name: Royal monopolies
laws.text: Salt, iron and wine pay the crown first.

laws.name: Debase the coin
laws.text: Less silver in every crown, and more crowns.

laws.name: Patronage of the temples
laws.text: The crown endows the temples of its faith.

laws.name: Missions abroad
laws.text: Priests go out with every envoy.

laws.name: A secular crown
laws.text: Temple lands taxed like any other.

laws.name: Tolerance of all faiths
laws.text: No town is punished for its gods.

laws.name: Seasonal levies
laws.text: Every village sends its sons when called.

laws.name: Forced marches
laws.text: The army marches at dawn and halts at dusk.
